main_text.p: pam) talem sententiam promulgauit, ac decretum edidit, ne rursus concilium ante quinquennium con-uocaretur, & inde ad decennium usq; protrahe-retur, ac deinceps à decennio in decennium gene-rali synodus ageretur. Martinus postea, peractis in itinere (ut distum est) duobus annis, Romam tan-dem diu expectatus peruenit: & urbem in exter-nis aedificijs ac caeremonijs Papalibus reformauit. Patrimonium Ecclesiae durissimis praelijs repete-bat: & ut peregrinus nummos afferentibus iter ef-fet tutum, uiarum latrones fugauit. Ludouicum A-louisij filium in Neapolitano regno confirmauit: atq; Alphonsum Arragonum eo priuauit. Schismata quaedam aduersus regnum Papisticum sustulit: ac Bononiam rebellantem, in caulam reuocauit. Germanos aduersus Bohemos ad arma ob haere-sim (ut uocant) concitauit: & Vualdenum Carme-litam Anglum ad scribendum contra Hussitas & Vuicleuistas inuitauit.

Cardinales plures creauit, & decreta Ponti-ficum in ipso schismate facta damnauit. Prospe-rum Columnam nepotem (uel spurium) habuit: & in suo Cardinalatu ad D. Georgium sibi succedere paterno animo fecit. Formulam contra stuum uen-ditionis & emptionis promulgauit, thesauros con-gregauit, & alia plura praeter Euangelij regulam egit,

page.notes: The scan shows show-through and a faint stain at the left and right edges, which were left out. The word "Schismata" at the start of the third line of the first paragraph is printed with a worn initial S and is read as Schismata[?]. Two words are read from a worn or cramped print: "distum" (printed as "diftum eft") and "Schismata", both as they appear. The catchword is absent; the last line ends the text on the page.
